name: vrange keeps the note ons between two velocities
about: vrange passes a note on whose velocity is in lo..hi, both ends included, and always passes a release, whatever its velocity.
notes: A note on (9n, v > 0) is kept when lo <= v <= hi. A missing lo is 1 and a missing hi is 127. A note off, a note on at velocity 0, and anything not a note pass.
l1 to soft is hi 63 and no lo, one open bound. l2 to mid is lo 40 hi 100, both bounds. Outputs follow link order, soft before mid.
t 0: v 1 (01). soft keeps it, its open bottom reaches 1. NEGATIVE CONTROL: below 40, dropped by mid.
t 1: v 39 (27). soft keeps it. Dropped by mid, one below its edge.
t 2: v 40 (28). Both keep it, the low edge of mid.
t 3: v 63 (3F). Both keep it, the top edge of soft.
t 4: v 64 (40). NEGATIVE CONTROL: dropped by soft, one above its edge. mid keeps it.
t 5: v 100 (64). Dropped by soft. mid keeps it, its top edge.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 6: v 101 (65), above both. Nothing out.
t 7: a note off with release velocity 127 (80 42 7F) passes both, though 127 is above both ranges. A release is never filtered on its velocity.
t 8: a note on at velocity 0 (90 41 00) is a release and passes both. Read as a note on, 0 is below every lo and it would be dropped, leaving note 65 sounding at mid.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 9: B0 07 05 is a CC, its value is not a velocity, and it passes both.
NEGATIVE CONTROL: l3 asks for lo 0, outside 1..127, and is refused bad-args.
